verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform. It has a published OpenAPI spec, an llms.txt index, API-key access, account-management APIs and webhooks for events, so an agent can reach core account data programmatically without a dashboard. However, the pack does not clearly document read access to the full picture. missing for 10: an explicit transaction-listing/read API for Synctera accounts, pending/authorization activity retrieval, document retrieval endpoints, any MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: Once an API key is issued in Sandbox, you can immediately start calling the APIs below.
With webhooks, Synctera will push updates to the integrator instead of the integrator pulling updates.
